notes: Manifest v99 closes the Phase 2A stale-stream correlation edge by matching local and server assistant state by requestId before messageId, while preserving browser-only presentation diagnostics over server-authoritative canonical state. It also relays bounded, redacted Whole Conversation Camera diagnostics through the existing client-debug channel so thread/message state, activity, request identity, terminal/transcript/network/context integrity, and raw diagnostic snapshots are visible in runtime logs without restoring browser snapshot authority.
